"''We'll leave the spice and take the credits back to Mos Eisley. The rest will follow.|The Pyke courier and a Pyke guard|}} A [[Gender|male]] [[Pyke]] '''courier''' worked for the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[9 ABY]]. He and three other Pykes encountered [[Marshal]] [[Cobb Vanth]] whilst in the marshal's [[Mos Pelgo territories|territories]]. While Vanth tried to convince the Pykes to leave, the courier attempted to draw on the marshal, only to be gunned down with two of his colleagues. ==Biography== {{Quote|Do you know where you are gentlemen?|Cobb Vanth confronts the Pykes|}} [[File:MeetingInterupted-BoBFCh6.png|thumb|left|300px|Cobb Vanth interrupts the Pyke's transaction.]] In [[9 ABY]], the [[Gender|male]] [[Pyke]] worked as a courier in the [[Pyke Syndicate]] during its [[War against the Pykes|takeover]] of the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He and three other Pykes went into Tatooine's [[Mos Pelgo territories]], consulting with his comrades about their cargo of [[spice]] and [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] over their [[landspeeder]] by some [[moisture vaporator]]s. While they discussed what to do with the cargo, [[Marshal]] [[Cobb Vanth]] of [[Freetown|Mos Pelgo]] approached the group. The courier reached for his [[blaster pistol]] when Vanth told him to think his decision through, the marshal gripping his own [[pistol]]. The courier and his comrades stared at Vanth, who said he ran things in the territories and offered the Pykes a chance to return to the rest of their syndicate without any commotion. Nodding at his colleagues, the courier pretended to abide with the marshal's terms by turned from Vanth. The Pyke then attempted to draw his [[blaster]] on Vanth, but the marshal drew quicker and shot down the courier and two of his three comrades as they attempted to make a move on their new adversary. The courier dropped [[Death|dead]] to the ground with a groan, and Vanth advised the Pyke's last remaining [[Unidentified Pyke courier 2|colleague]] to flee with a warning for the syndicate. ==Personality and traits== A male Pyke with [[Color|blue]] and beige skin, the courier faked his compliance with Cobb Vanth in an attempt to take the marshal by surprise, the effort leading only to his demise. ==Equipment== The Pyke courier wore brown and black [[clothing]] with a brown [[belt]] and [[boot]]s and a dark [[helmet]] with an orange [[breath mask]]. He wielded a blaster pistol. ==Behind the scenes== The Pyke courier appeared in "[[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'' which was directed by [[Dave Filoni]] and released on [[February 2]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-february-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in February 2022}} ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი პაიკი კურიერი 1 }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Pyke Syndicate members]] [[Category:Pykes]]
